slotRules.basis: Conservative Gladiator PvE community priorities: skill goals first, then applicable offensive or utility keepers. Kanon supplies slot-specific rare-line preferences, not a numerical DPS ranking; equal ranks are alternatives, not required simultaneous rolls.

priorities.label: Overhead Slam +1
priorities.reason: Reach the level16 cooldown specialty first, then level20 for the third specialty slot; select the specialty in game.

priorities.label: Rending Blow +1
priorities.reason: A core Gladiator damage skill in the reviewed group route; preserve a useful existing line.

priorities.label: Ruinous Blow +1
priorities.reason: A core skill and buff action in the reviewed Gladiator route.

priorities.label: Combat Speed
priorities.reason: Community Gladiator preference: fit more actions into damage windows; no universal speed target is assumed.

priorities.label: Weapon Damage Boost
priorities.reason: The class guide prefers this damage multiplier before Damage Boost after skill and Combat Speed goals.

priorities.label: Damage Boost
priorities.reason: General damage line listed by both guides; a useful keeper, not a guaranteed best roll.

priorities.label: Might
priorities.reason: Offensive primary stat listed by both reviewed guides; compare the actual roll and total build.

priorities.label: Multi-hit Chance
priorities.reason: Offensive keeper listed for weapons; tied here because relative value changes with the build.

priorities.label: Attack
priorities.reason: Useful offensive fallback from the per-slot keep-list; it is not an instruction to replace a stronger existing roll.

priorities.label: Precision
priorities.reason: Conditional accuracy/critical support; its value depends on your target and existing stats. No unverified cap is used.

priorities.label: Critical Hit
priorities.reason: Conditional support for attacks that can benefit; no fixed critical target or universal cap is assumed.
